description:
EC-Earth3 workflow with wrappers running in MareNostrum 4 with Autosubmit v3.15.0b0, used to assess the effects of task aggregation on queueing times. Workflow configuration is based on the Auto-EC-Earth3's testing suite [1].
    
In order to reduce the size of the workflow, files in the _/tmp_ directory have been deleted. Additionally, the experiment has been cleaned up with the Autosubmit [`clean`](https://autosubmit.readthedocs.io/en/master/userguide/manage/index.html#how-to-clean-the-experiment) command. The experiment requires to refetch the project sources. Platform-related identifiers have been anonymized in the configuration files and marked with angle brackets.

[1] Garcia Lopez, A., Arriola Meikle, L., Montane Pinto, G., Castrillo, M., de Paula Kinoshita, B., Ferrer Escuin, E., and Gaya Avila, A.: Enabling reliable workflow development with an advanced Testing Suite, EGU General Assembly 2025, Vienna, Austria, 27 Apr-2 May 2025, EGU25-8305, https://doi.org/10.5194/egusphere-egu25-8305, 2025.
name: EC-Earth3 workflow with wrappers in MareNostrum 4
